source_text:
Quid est homo
Ἐπιστολὴ τοῦ μακαριωτάτου καὶ φιλοσοφωτάτου κυρίου Ἰωάννου
πρεσβυτέρου τοῦ ∆αμασκηνοῦ, πρός τινα πεμφθεῖσα. Τί ἐστιν ἄνθρωπος;
95.244
Ἄνθρωπός ἐστι ζῶον λογικὸν θνητὸν, νοῦ καὶ ἐπιστήμης δεκτικόν· συνίσταται δὲ ἐκ
τεσσάρων στοιχείων, ἤγουν ἐξ αἵματος, φλέγματος, χολῆς ξανθῆς, καὶ χολῆς
μελαίνης. Καὶ τῷ μὲν αἵματι ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ, καὶ ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ τὸ πνεῦμα· ἡ δὲ χολὴ ἡ
ξανθὴ, ἐν τῷ ἥπατι καὶ ἐν τῷ στομάχῳ· ἡ δὲ μελαίνη χολὴ, ἐν τῇ σπλήνῃ, καὶ ἐν τῇ
ψόᾳ· τὸ δὲ φλέγμα, ἐν τῷ ἐγκεφάλῳ καὶ ἐν τῇ κοίτῃ.
thought_title: Definition of a Human Being and the Four Humors
orientation: John of Damascus opens his letter by defining what a human being is and then locating each of the four humors in its bodily seat.
pass_a_gloss: Letter of the most blessed and most philosophical lord John, priest of Damascus, sent to someone. What is a human being? A human being is a rational mortal animal, capable of intellect and knowledge; and it is composed of four elements, namely of blood, phlegm, yellow bile, and black bile. And the blood indeed is in the heart, and in the heart is the breath; and the yellow bile is in the liver and in the stomach; and the black bile is in the spleen and in the loins; and the phlegm is in the brain and in the chest.

choices.why: Matches the fixed glossary rendering for the definitional phrase.
Uses the fixed glossary rendering for this capacity phrase.
rejected: able to receive intellect and knowledge

choices.why: Fixed glossary rendering for the four bodily components.
Literal rendering of πνεῦμα in its bodily sense here, distinct from soul.
κοίτη literally means a bed or resting place; here it denotes the chest cavity as the seat of phlegm, rendered plainly.
Renders the explanatory particle literally and clearly.

pass_b_english: A human being is a rational mortal animal, capable of intellect and knowledge. It is composed of four elements: namely, blood, phlegm, yellow bile, and black bile.

Blood has its seat in the heart, and the breath is in the heart as well. Yellow bile is in the liver and in the stomach. Black bile is in the spleen and in the loins. Phlegm is in the brain and in the chest.

last_rejected.quote: the breath is in the heart as well
last_rejected.why: Glossary requires 'spirit' not 'breath' for πνεῦμα in this context.
last_rejected.fix: and the spirit is in the heart as well
last_rejected.ruling: πνεῦμα can mean 'breath' or 'spirit'; no glossary shown; rendering within normal range, not a major error.

polish.changed: Clarified the speaker and subject throughout, kept each humor's bodily seat consistent, and smoothed the sentence rhythm for reading aloud.

notes.quote: Blood has its seat in the heart

variants.text: Blood has its seat in the heart
blood in the right part above the liver

notes.why: Blood's seat shifts from heart to above liver; reader loses track.
notes.fix: Note variant anatomical schemes or textual layers.

notes.quote: Yellow bile is in the liver and in the stomach

variants.text: Yellow bile is in the liver and in the stomach
yellow bile in the left part above the spleen

notes.why: Yellow bile's seat changes from liver/stomach to above spleen.
notes.fix: Explain conflicting sources or textual compilation.

notes.quote: Black bile is in the spleen and in the loins

variants.text: Black bile is in the spleen and in the loins
black bile in the loins above the kidneys

notes.why: Black bile loses spleen, gains kidneys; reader thinks different humor.
notes.fix: Flag as variant scheme or possible textual corruption.

notes.quote: Phlegm is in the brain and in the chest

variants.text: Phlegm is in the brain and in the chest
phlegm in the chest above the breath

notes.why: Phlegm loses brain, gains 'above the breath'; inconsistent mapping.
notes.fix: Note brain dropped in second scheme, or 'breath' as heart-lung.

notes.quote: Blood has its seat in the heart

variants.text: Blood has its seat in the heart
blood in the right part above the liver

notes.why: Blood's seat is heart in one section, above liver in another.
notes.fix: Note the two traditions or harmonize the seat of blood.

notes.quote: Yellow bile is in the liver and in the stomach.

variants.text: Yellow bile is in the liver and in the stomach.
yellow bile in the left part above the spleen

notes.why: Yellow bile's seat is liver/stomach in one, above spleen in another.
notes.fix: Note the discrepancy or harmonize yellow bile's location.

notes.quote: Black bile is in the spleen and in the loins.

variants.text: Black bile is in the spleen and in the loins.
black bile in the loins above the kidneys

notes.why: Black bile's seat includes spleen in one, only loins/kidneys in another.
notes.fix: Note the discrepancy or harmonize black bile's location.

notes.quote: Phlegm is in the brain and in the chest.

variants.text: Phlegm is in the brain and in the chest.
phlegm in the chest above the breath

notes.why: Phlegm's seat includes brain in one, only chest in another.
notes.fix: Note the discrepancy or harmonize phlegm's location.

notes.quote: the breath is in the heart as well
notes.why: 'The breath' is unexplained; likely pneuma/spirit but not clarified.
notes.fix: Identify 'breath' as pneuma or vital spirit.
